settings.title: Hero Section Settings
settings.description: Sets the banner image upload limit, the banner cache time on user screens, and the public asset disk for banner files.

max_upload_mb.label: Maximum image size (MB)
max_upload_mb.hint: Maximum size of one banner image (1–10). Files larger than the server PHP upload_max_filesize or post_max_size are still rejected even if this value is higher.
max_upload_mb.over_server_limit: This value is larger than the server limit ({{mb}}MB). Files over that limit cannot be uploaded.

max_video_upload_mb.label: Maximum video size (MB)
max_video_upload_mb.hint: Maximum size of one banner video file (MP4, WEBM), 1 to 100. Files larger than the server PHP upload_max_filesize or post_max_size are still rejected even if this value is higher.

public_cache_minutes.label: Banner cache time on user screens (minutes)
public_cache_minutes.hint: Set 0 to disable caching (0–60). Saving, deleting or reordering banners is reflected immediately, and the cache also expires at scheduled start and end times.

public_asset_disk.label: Public Asset Disk
public_asset_disk.hint: Select to store banner images and videos on a different disk. Leave empty to follow the core public asset disk setting. A change applies to newly uploaded files; files already uploaded keep being served from the disk they were uploaded to. The public disk serves files without PHP only when storage:link exists on the server.
public_asset_disk.unavailable: The saved disk ({disk}) is no longer available, so banner files are being streamed. Select another disk and save to change it.

plugin_read_only: You do not have permission to change this plugin's settings, so they are shown read-only.

admin.title: Hero Section
admin.description: Manage the banners shown at the top of the site home, shop main, board, product, category and other pages, by position.

position.hint: A position is a hero section slot (extension point) provided by the user template.
position.unregistered_notice: The extension (module or plugin) that adds this position is turned off, so these banners are not shown on the site. They are kept, and appear again when the extension is turned back on. On this tab you can only review, edit and delete them.
position.no_auto_output: The extension that adds this position does not say how to read the target from the page address (route_param), so the hero section does not fill the site slot itself. If that extension ships its own output fragment, banners still show; otherwise they do not appear on the site.
position.load_failed: Could not load the positions. Select Retry to try again.
position.missing: This position does not exist right now. The extension that added it is turned off and no banners are left, or the address is wrong. Choose another position from the tabs above.

target.pick_first: Choose a {{target}} first. Banners appear only on the chosen {{target}} page.
target.missing: The chosen {{target}} could not be found (it may have been deleted). Its banners are kept but not shown on the site, and new banners cannot be added.

target_list.title: {{target}} items with banners or own settings
target_list.summary: Banners in this position: {{banners}} · Targets with banners: {{targets}}
target_list.empty: No {{target}} has banners yet. Find and choose a {{target}} above to add the first banner.
target_list.new_hint: To add banners to a {{target}} that has none yet, find and choose it in the picker above.
target_list.load_failed: Could not load the target list.

preview.title: Showing now: {{count}}
preview.empty_with_counts: No banners are showing right now. ({{scheduled}} scheduled · {{inactive}} hidden · {{ended}} ended)
preview.render_failed: The preview could not be displayed. Check the banner text and open it again.

slider.title: Slider settings
slider.width_hint: Full screen width stretches the image edge to edge and keeps the title and button aligned with the page content. On screens wider than 1920px the height stops at 640px (or the maximum height below, if set) and the image is cropped top and bottom around its focus point.
slider.max_height_hint: The banner grows with its aspect ratio and stops at this height; images that overflow are cropped top and bottom around their focus point. Desktop & tablet means screens 768px wide or wider; mobile means 767px or narrower. Leave empty to follow the ratio (full screen width stops at 640px). {{min}}–{{max}}px.
slider.max_height_invalid: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}px, or leave it empty.
slider.max_height_overlay_tight: With menu overlay on, the text starts below the menu. If the maximum height is under {{min}}px the text area gets tight and may scroll, so check it on the site (the editing preview does not overlay the menu).
slider.header_overlay_hint: Lays the site menu transparently over the banner. The menu gets its background back when visitors scroll down, and its text color follows the background set for each banner.
slider.header_overlay_needs_full: Menu overlay only applies on the site when the width is "Full screen width".
slider.pagination_hint: Shown when there are two or more banners. The progress bar shows the time left until the next banner; banner name tabs show only bars on phones. The pill counter shows previous and next buttons with the number below the text on the left, and the side arrows are hidden.
slider.scope_dynamic: Defaults for the {{position}} position. Items not set for each {{target}} follow these values.

list.empty_filtered: No banners match these conditions. Try another status or search term.
list.slot_missing: The current site template has no slot for this banner position. Banners you add may not appear on the site.

empty_position.title: No banners in {{position}} yet.
empty_position.sizes: Recommended image size: PC 1920×640, mobile 750×1000 (without a mobile image, the PC image is cropped to portrait).

reorder.title: Reorder banners
reorder.description: Drag rows or use the ↑↓ buttons, then press [Save]. The user page and preview follow the new order.

delete.title: Delete banner
delete.warning: The banner and its PC and mobile images are deleted right away and cannot be restored. To take it down temporarily, hide it instead.

form.description: Set the banner text, images, link and display period. The preview shows your unsaved input.
form.position_hint: A hero section slot provided by the current user template.
form.target_hint: This banner appears only on the chosen {{target}} page.
form.target_missing: The {{target}} of this banner could not be found (it may have been deleted). You can still save it, but it is not shown on the site until you choose another {{target}}.
form.position_unregistered: This position is not registered — the extension that adds it is turned off, so the banner is not shown on the site. You can still edit it or move it to another position.
form.is_active_hint: When off, the banner is hidden on the user page regardless of its period (inactive).
form.locale_hint: You can enter text for each language enabled on the site. Empty languages show the site default language text.
form.eyebrow_hint: A short line shown small above the title (optional). It follows the title alignment.
form.title: Title
form.button_text_hint: If filled, only the button is a link; if empty, the whole banner is a link.
form.image_alt_hint: Read aloud to visitors who cannot see the screen. If empty, the title is read.

image.pc_hint: Recommended 1920×640 · up to {{mb}}MB · JPG, PNG, WEBP
image.mobile_hint: Optional · recommended 750×1000 · up to {{mb}}MB · Without it, mobile shows the PC image.
image.size_mismatch: The uploaded image is {{width}}×{{height}}. It differs from the recommended size ({{recommended}}) and may be cropped on some screens.
image.pc_promo_hint: Desktop artwork for the artwork column. It keeps its aspect ratio, so a landscape transparent PNG or WebP that fits the width beside the text (e.g. 1480×800) works best. Up to {{mb}}MB.

form.link_url_hint: Only site paths (starting with /) or http(s) URLs are allowed.

period.hint: If saved now, the banner will be {{status}}.
period.incomplete: Enter both the start and end date and time.

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Upload a PC image to see the preview.
preview.fallback: Missing text falls back to the site language ({{locale}}) or another available language.
preview.text_overflow: On {{device}} the text is taller than the banner. Nothing is cut off — visitors can scroll inside the text area to read it all — but shorten the text if you want it visible at once. You can still save.
preview.text_overflow_controls: On {{device}} the text becomes taller than the banner when two or more banners share this position and the slide buttons appear. Nothing is cut off — visitors can scroll inside the text area — but shorten the text if you want it visible at once. You can still save.
preview.contrast_low: The text may be hard to read against its background — {{parts}}. This is an estimate from the photo's overall average brightness and the text backdrop, so the real contrast behind the text may differ; check the preview. Text colors are never changed automatically.
preview.contrast_title: title contrast about {{ratio}}:1 (3:1 or more recommended)
preview.contrast_description: description contrast about {{ratio}}:1 (4.5:1 or more recommended)
preview.contrast_tip_light: For light text, choose "{{option}}" as the text background or place the text over a darker part of the photo.
preview.contrast_tip_dark: For dark text, choose "{{option}}" as the text background or switch the text color to a white tone.

form.upload_pending: An image upload is pending. Retry or remove any failed files before saving.
form.conflict: Another administrator saved changes first. Your input is preserved. Open the latest banner in another tab to compare your changes.
form.conflict_compare: Open the latest banner in another tab

presentation.title: Image framing and text background
presentation.hint: PC uses 1920×640 and mobile uses 750×1000. If no mobile image is uploaded, the PC image is cropped. Adjust the focal points to keep important content visible.

text_layout.title: Text position & effect
text_layout.hint: Set the text position separately for PC and phone. You can also drag the text in the preview on the right.
text_layout.width_hint: Maximum width of the text box relative to the banner (the content width for full-width banners). Narrower boxes make shorter lines.
text_layout.animation_hint: Each time the banner appears, the eyebrow, title, description and button appear in turn, 0.2 seconds apart. "Letter by letter" applies to the eyebrow and title; the description and button fade in. Visitors who turned on reduced motion see the text without effects.
text_layout.tone_hint: When "Menu overlay" is on in the position settings, the site menu text color changes while this banner is shown.
text_layout.drag_label: Text position {{x}}% horizontal, {{y}}% vertical — drag or use the arrow keys to move
text_layout.drag_hint: Drag the text in the preview, or select it and use the arrow keys (10% at a time with Shift).
text_layout.promo_spot_hint: In the promotion layout, a horizontal position above 50 puts the text on the right and the artwork on the left. On mobile, a vertical position below 50 puts the text above; otherwise the artwork is above. The vertical position is the height inside the text column.

conflict_merge.title: Compare the latest version with my changes
conflict_merge.hint: Fields changed only by another admin use the latest value, and fields changed only by you keep your value. Choose a value for fields both of you changed, apply, then review and save again.
conflict_merge.no_differences: Your input matches the latest version. Apply to save again on top of the latest version.
conflict_merge.load_failed: Could not load the latest version. Your input is kept. Please try again.
conflict_merge.choose_all: Choose a value for every field both of you changed to apply.
conflict_merge.stale_image: This image was already replaced or removed by another admin and cannot be reused.
conflict_merge.stale_video: This video was already replaced or removed by another admin and cannot be reused.

form.button_needs_link: Enter a link URL for the button to appear on the site. Without a URL, the button text is not shown.

link_behavior.button: On the site, pressing the button opens this URL.
link_behavior.whole: There is no button text, so pressing anywhere on the banner opens this URL.
link_behavior.none: There is no link URL, so pressing the banner on the site does nothing.

save_blocked.pc_image: Upload a PC image to save.
save_blocked.go_pc_image: Go to the PC image field
save_blocked.pc_video: Upload a PC video to save.
save_blocked.go_pc_video: Go to the PC video field
save_blocked.settings_loading: Positions are still loading, so you cannot save yet.
save_blocked.settings_failed: Positions could not be loaded, so you cannot save.
save_blocked.position_missing: The selected position does not exist, so the banner cannot be saved. Choose a position again.

media.image_hint: Shows the image uploaded below as the banner.
media.video_hint: Plays the uploaded video muted and automatically, then moves to the next banner when it ends (loops when there is only one banner).
media.pc_video_hint: Up to {{mb}}MB · MP4, WEBM · Landscape video (16:9 etc.) recommended.
media.mobile_video_hint: Optional · Up to {{mb}}MB · MP4, WEBM · Without it, phones play the PC video.
media.poster_hint: For video banners this image is the poster. It is shown instead of the video while the video loads and for visitors who reduce motion.

layout.title: Banner layout
layout.label: Layout
layout.background_hint: The image or video covers the whole banner and the text sits on top (the existing style).
layout.promo_hint: Splits a background color into a text column and an artwork column. On desktop they sit side by side; on mobile they stack. Artwork keeps its aspect ratio and is not cropped. Type text in the text fields instead of putting it in the image.
layout.preset_hint: Text at middle-left on desktop at 40% width, artwork above text on mobile, sequential entrance, artwork from the right, default white text turned dark, and an empty background filled with light gray and set to a "Light" banner background — you can change everything afterwards, and slider settings are not changed.

applied.values: Applied settings: {{effect}} · {{width}} · {{pagination}} · max height desktop {{pc}} / mobile {{mobile}}
applied.from_target: Includes settings for this target only. Change them in "Settings for this target" on the banner list.
applied.from_position: These are the position defaults. Change them in the slider settings on the banner list.

target_settings.title: Settings for this target
target_settings.scope: Applies only to {{target}} in the {{position}} position. Only items marked "This target only" are saved; the rest follow the position defaults above.
target_settings.missing: This target no longer exists. You cannot save new settings, but you can reset the remaining ones to the position defaults.
target_settings.load_failed: Could not load settings for this target. Your changes are preserved. Please try again.
